title: File Input: Sizes (daisyUI)
notes:
File Input is an input field for uploading files.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/file-input/+page.md
code:
<input type="file" class="file-input file-input-xs" />

<input type="file" class="file-input file-input-sm" />

<input type="file" class="file-input file-input-md" />

<input type="file" class="file-input file-input-lg" />

<input type="file" class="file-input file-input-xl" />
